candidate_record_template.gate_reason_format: code=violates_must_have|unknown_critical; criterion; basis; limits. not_applicable and unknown_minor belong in criterion notes/unknowns, not in gate_reasons

instructions: Copy candidate_record_template into candidates and fill observed evidence. offer_evidence links the observed price to the exact SKU, listing, shop and quantity; listing_ref equals a candidate URL, share code, product_id or listing_locator. Use exactly the same source reference as costs.goods.source. Set delivery_destination to saved_cn_warehouse only when verified; do not copy the address. Discount kind is none, conditional or unknown; for conditional record actual terms, applicability, ordinary price and source. Run scripts/validate_offer_evidence.py on the session before final recommendations, treating problems as unverified and explaining them. A clean check verifies internal consistency only. For decision-changing requirements store source_quote, criterion, origin and status. Gate reasons use codes: violates_must_have, unknown_critical; not_applicable is an applicability note, not a gate reason. Do not treat null as zero. Do not turn unknown into absent. favorite_action is separate from gate: none, saved, cannot_save, removed. Increment requirements_revision when a requirement changes; re-evaluate affected candidates and resume their next_check instead of upgrading status automatically; 'can pay more' does not set a new ceiling. Do not include secrets or full addresses. Use the private owner route without copying full address/phone here. Run the price script with --basis china unless landed cost was explicitly requested. Unknown international freight does not block normal selection.
